title: Cast-R1: Learning Tool-Augmented Sequential Decision Policies for Time Series Forecasting

claim.summary: Cast-R1 learns tool-augmented forecasting decisions with state memory, feature/model calls and forecast revision, using supervised and reinforcement training.

modules.name: Incremental decision-state memory
modules.scope_reason: Summarizing tool outputs and past actions into subsequent states is domain-independent context management; no temporal-specific retrieval rule is specified.

modules.name: Preparation-forecasting-refinement workflow
modules.scope_reason: The action sequence selects forecast models and revises a target-horizon prediction.

modules.name: Two-stage forecasting-policy training
modules.scope_reason: Supervised and reinforcement stages change the model policy for tool use and sequential forecasting.
